tips_en: Start with Apodex 1.1 (Paper 1) for the broadest systems-level perspective on long-horizon agentic intelligence, then follow up with MobilePA-Bench (Paper 3)—they form a natural pair, as the benchmark explicitly highlights the tool-orchestration and sub-agent coordination gaps that systems like Apodex aim to address. EchoWM (Paper 2) is a standalone topic on omnimodal world models and can be read independently based on your interest in generative media.
tips_zh: 建议先阅读 Apodex 1.1（论文 1），它从系统层面最全面地阐述了长周期智能体的设计；再读 MobilePA-Bench（论文 3），这两篇高度互补——该基准正揭示了 Apodex 这类系统所要解决的多工具编排与子智能体协调难题。EchoWM（论文 2）属于多模态世界模型方向，可根据你对生成式媒体的兴趣独立阅读。
